requirements.quote: (To be typed and submitted in the Letter Head of the Company/Firm of Bidder failing which the offer of Bidder is liable to be summarily rejected)
requirements.text: The declaration must be typed and submitted on the bidder's letterhead.

requirements.quote: The Proprietor, Partner(s), Director(s) of our Company/Firm DO NOT have any relation or relatives employed in ITI
requirements.text: Declare if no relations of the bidder's proprietors, partners, or directors are employed in ITI.

requirements.quote: The Proprietor, Partner(s), or Director(s) of our Company/Firm have relation/relatives employed in ITI and their particulars are as below:
requirements.text: Declare if any relations of the bidder's proprietors, partners, or directors are employed in ITI, providing details.

requirements.quote: Attach separate sheet, if necessary. If ITI Management comes to know at a later date that the information furnished by the Bidder is false, ITI reserves the right to take suitable action against the Bidder/Contractor.
requirements.text: Provide additional sheets if needed; false information may lead to action by ITI.
